title: RE.DEF.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 183 (EVOL-21). RE-DEF (redefinitions) is the subject; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and VT-ALGN. From CULT-INFO-B: DOC (documentation) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: IST-F (isolated focus) and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From VT-ALGN: PER-DY (perception dynamics).
